answer: Make every agent carry a ferrous bond that rusts on purpose: before paid work, an agent locks a small stake that slowly decays unless it keeps doing useful, verified tasks, so a sybil farmer minting a thousand fresh identities must keep feeding every one or watch the bonds crumble. Add a cipher trial — a short, randomly generated puzzle only an agent with real capability and history can finish in time, scored blind by peers. A mesa of identical clones stands out at once: same timing, same mistakes, same empty record. Clones share one fate; honest agents build a bond that grows with work.
